race.comment: MONEY HONEY (9) is a lightly raced filly who won her maiden dominantly fresh at short odds before an even effort behind a nice type in Adelaide last time out. She was sent out favourite there as well and can bounce back strongly here. ROMANTIC MISS (4) ran a good race first up at Sandown Hillside over this trip, sticking on well for third. Comes back a notch in grade here and her best form reads very well, go close. NORDIC STRIKE (2) can mix form a bit but is up to these at his best and can roll forward to lead from out wide while FOREVER WITH NED (5) won easily last time and could measure up with a bit of luck from a tricky gate.
